Message.Name: Spot Gold Random End Message
Message.Description: Spot Gold Random End. Reports random extension of the call auction window when conditional random-end is triggered.

Field.Name: Message sequence number
Field.Description: A message sequence number given by Market data team - Market data: seq number is given by instruments and boards (※ only for high-bandwidth service) - Batch Data: seq number is given by Information Ca.

Field.Name: Board ID
Field.Description: The Board ID refers to each Board in which an issue is traded under different trading schedules and rules. Individual issue can be traded on more than two Boards under each Board's schedule and with d.

Field.Name: A designated number for an issue
Field.Description: A designated number for each issue on a daily basis - Market(Information Product) : KOSPI(Securities A, Securities C), KOSDAQ(Securities B), KONEX(Securities B), Derivatives(DRV A), Spot Gold(Commodit.

Field.Name: Random End Trigger Code
Field.Description: 1: Trigger of Random End in the opening single price session 2: Removal of Random End in the opening single price session 3: Trigger of Random End in the closing single price session 4: Removal of Ran.
